    r."hours"
FROM "restaurant" r

        LOWER(r."service_format") LIKE '%buffet%'
        OR LOWER(r."service_format") LIKE '%coffee%'

        (regexp_match(r."hours", '(\d{1,2}:\d{2})'))[1] IS NOT NULL

      )
ORDER BY r."name";
